Description: Create and decorate recycling bins for different types of materials (plastic, paper, glass) and place them at school.\nObjectives: Promote environmental care and ecological awareness.\nSkills Developed: Creativity, social responsibility, collaborative work.

Description: Publish a school magazine where students write articles, conduct interviews, and design the layout.\nObjectives: Develop communication, writing, and graphic design skills.\nSkills Developed: Creativity, project management, communication skills.

Description: Create and maintain a garden at school, where students grow and care for various plants.\nObjectives: Learn about agriculture, sustainability, and healthy eating. \nSkills Developed: Teamwork, responsibility, environmental care.

Description: Organize a fundraising campaign or donations for a charitable cause. \nObjectives: Foster empathy and solidarity.\nSkills Developed: Project management, communication skills, social responsibility.

Description: Organize an event at school where students present their business ideas or innovative projects to their peers and teachers.\nObjectives: Develop presentation and idea defense skills.\nSkills Developed: Creativity, presentation skills, self-confidence.

Description: Create a temporary store where used books donated by students and teachers are sold.\nObjectives: Foster a love for reading and reuse. \nSkills Developed: Inventory management, sales skills, money management.

Steve Jobs was a visionary and charismatic entrepreneur who left an indelible mark on the technology industry. Together with Steve Wozniak and Ronald Wayne, Jobs founded Apple Computer, Inc. in 1976 in the garage of his home.
In what year did Steve Jobs found Apple Computer, Inc.?

Jobs played a crucial role in the development of iconic products such as the Apple I, Apple II, iMac, iPod, iPhone, and iPad. These products revolutionized their respective markets and changed the way we interact with technology.
Which of the following products are iconic to Apple Computer, Inc.?
In addition to Apple, Jobs also acquired Pixar in 1986, which became a successful animation company, producing films such as \"Toy Story\" and \"Finding Nemo\".
What was the name of the company that Steve Jobs acquired in 1986?
